title: Pause hidden-tab polling and fetch messages incrementally
description: Reduce microCMS transfer by skipping fetch/delete polling while hidden, fetching only messages newer than the last seen timestamp, merging deltas safely, forwarding API query options, and assigning POST response IDs to optimistic messages.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover empty, ordering, duplicate-ID, and optimistic-message merge cases; visibility guards and resume refresh are implemented; GET forwards orders/filters; incremental fetch and POST ID reconciliation are implemented; yarn lint, yarn test, and yarn build pass.
close_reason: Implemented hidden-tab polling guards and resume refresh, incremental message fetching/merging, API query forwarding, POST ID reconciliation, and passing unit/static/build verification.

title: Delete stale system logs from microCMS
description: Strictly identify generated system-log formats and periodically delete system logs older than 24 hours without deleting regular chat messages.
acceptance_criteria: False-positive chat examples are rejected; stale system-log cleanup is covered by mocked tests; cleanup API and client interval integration are implemented; lint, test, and build pass.

title: Hide stale system logs and show chat timestamps
description: Use TDD to add message visibility and timestamp formatting utilities, ensure optimistic messages carry createdAt, render timestamps for chat messages only, and add a lightweight Vitest setup.
acceptance_criteria: Vitest covers system-log detection, 24-hour visibility boundaries, chat visibility regardless of age, and timestamp formatting; page rendering uses createdAt; lint, tests, and production build pass.
notes: TDD RED confirmed on missing message-utils module. GREEN/REFACTOR complete with 9 Vitest tests passing. yarn lint and yarn build are blocked in this sandbox because node_modules was absent and registry DNS failed (next executable unavailable); source files have zero TypeScript syntax diagnostics and git diff --check passes.
